reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable and lectures were fun and interesting. If you do the bare minimum you'll get a B on grades but actually try and you'll get an A. Loved going to class because she was amazing. Talk and be open about your opinions.

Took her online, honestly the class felt like a participation grade rather then getting any real feedback. The lecture material on ecampus was minimal at best, there was a textbook but I never used it. Just go through the motions and you'll get a near perfect score in the class without an ounce of real effort, if thats what youre looking for.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Price is very good at ensuring her class learns the basics of writing and at going over exactly what each paper requires. She also has in-class workshops where students can go to her for help/advice with current projects. All in all, a very kind teacher who works hard to help you develop your writing skills.
SUPER tough grader and very harsh comments on essays. Doesn't really give any positive feedback and is rude when you ask questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.
